properties.name: Ilala
properties.derivation: Union of the ward polygons drawn on the map for Ilala: 23 OSM boundary polygons + 7 COD-AB 2018 polygons (clipped to areas not already OSM-mapped) + 1 flagged OSM extra, intersected with the region boundary. OSM has no municipal boundary relations for Dar es Salaam (admin_level 6/7).
properties.aligned: 2026-11-24 partition pass - district edges follow the drawn ward polygons exactly and neighbouring districts tessellate.
